title: नागरिकमैत्री नेपाली सेना Nagarikmaitri Nepali Sena
authors: अधिकारी Adhikari, द्वारिका Dwarika कुमारी Kumari
nepali: स्त्री–पुरुष सबैलाई समेटिएको नागरिक देशका जनतार रक्षक हुन् । स्वतन्त्र सार्वभौम राष्ट्र भएकाले नेपालीनागरिकहरुको इज्जत र सम्मान संसारभरि यथावत्कायम रहेको छ । जुनसुकै युद्धमा होस् वा अन्य देशभक्तिका क्षेत्रमा होस्, नारी र पुरुषहरु गैरसैनिकभए पनि राष्ट्रको रक्षाका निम्ति बलिवेदीमा चढेकाछन् । उनीहरुको साहस र हिम्मतलाई इतिहासलेस्वर्ण अक्षरले लेखेको छ । सैनिक परिवारको आश्रित परिवारलाई मात्रै लिइयो भने नागरिक र सैनिक सम्बन्धअपूरो हुन्छ । नेपालको इतिहासको कालखण्डलाईपल्टाएर हेर्ने हो भने, नागरिक र सैनिक सम्बन्ध नङर मासु जस्तै जोडिएको छ । हरेक युद्धका मोर्चा तथा लोककल्याणकारी कार्यहरुमा नागरिकहरुले सेनालाईसाथ दिएका छन् । नेपाली सेनाले जनताको रक्षा गर्दै नागरिकहरुको सम्मान गरेका छन् । स्वास्थ्य शिविर, सरसफाई, प्राकृतिक प्रकोप, विकास निर्माणमा नेपालीसेनाले पु¥याएको सेवा नागरिक सम्बन्धको अतुलनीय उदाहरण हो ।
american_english: Citizens, encompassing both women and men, are the people and protectors of the nation. Because it is an independent, sovereign nation, the honor and respect of Nepali citizens remain intact throughout the world. Whether in any war or in other spheres of patriotism, women and men, even though they are non-military, have ascended the sacrificial altar for the defense of the nation. History has recorded their courage and bravery in golden letters. If only the dependent families of military families are taken, the civil–military relationship is incomplete. If one turns over the periods of Nepal's history and looks, the civil–military relationship is joined like nail and flesh. In every war front and in welfare-oriented public works, citizens have supported the army. The Nepali Army, protecting the people, has honored the citizens. The service rendered by the Nepali Army in health camps, sanitation, natural disasters and development construction is an incomparable example of the civil–military relationship.

informal_english: Sure, citizens — women and men alike — are the people and protectors of the country. Seeing as we're an independent, sovereign nation, the honour and respect of Nepali citizens holds firm right across the world. Whether it's in any war or in other patriotic fields, women and men, non-military though they are, have gone to the sacrificial altar for the defence of the nation. History has written their courage and bravery in letters of gold, it has. If you only take the dependent families of military families, the civil–military relationship is incomplete, altogether. If you turn the pages of the periods of Nepal's history, the civil–military relationship is joined like nail and flesh. On every front of war and in public welfare work, citizens have stood by the army. The Nepali Army has protected the people and honoured the citizens. The service the Nepali Army has given in health camps, cleanliness drives, natural disasters and development construction is an incomparable example of the civil–military relationship, so it is.

'नङ र मासु जस्तै' (nail and flesh, i.e. inseparable) rendered literally as 'nail and flesh'. 'सरसफाई' rendered as sanitation (US/UK/AU) and 'cleanliness drives' in informal.
